description: FIGI check digit. Twelve characters with no vowels. The first two are letters and are not BS, BM, GG, GB or VG, and the third character is G. The check uses the full A–Z alphabet, weights 1 and 2 from the left. Spaces are ignored. This does not call OpenFIGI. Returns JSON with: valid, compact, kind, reason, check. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/figi-validate
name: figi_validate
title: Figi Validate
